title: Invertibility and the composition equation of the fixed derived-pullback counits
statement: Use exactly the additive structures and left-derived counits selected in exists_derivedPullbackComposition, hence the counits defining perfectHomComposition [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. The fixed counit is invertible at the quotient of each K-flat module-sheaf complex [def-pc-kflat-complex]. For composable maps f,g and a homotopy complex K, perfectHomComposition(f,g) followed by the direct counit equals Lf applied to the g counit, followed by the f counit on the g tensor-pullback model, followed by localization of the underived composition mate. The same underived mate lifts degreewise to complexes and homotopy categories. Derived pullback and its universal property are those of [def-pc-derived-pullback].

proof.text: Expose the precise witnesses already used by perfectHomComposition; additive structures are propositions and the counits are specified by the left-derived universal property. This introduces no arbitrary model choice.

Extract the original K-flat counit invertibility theorem from derived pullback. Both the original and the fixed counits give the same left-derived functor. The universal comparison between them is invertible, and its factorization equation transfers invertibility at K-flat complexes.

Evaluate the defining leftDerivedLift factorization equation of perfectHomComposition at K. Remove the identity components of associators; the three remaining factors are exactly the claimed counit equation. Lift the fixed underived mate to complexes and homotopy by mapHomologicalComplexCompIso and mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso.
